howto.title: How it works
howto.s1: Every Pokémon, or just some generations, types, starters or legendaries. Regional forms, Megas and other forms can join in.
howto.s2: Each screen shows a handful of Pokémon: keep up to {keep} and move on, and the rest drop out. A big pool takes a couple of quick rounds, and your progress is saved on this device.
howto.s3: When {max} or fewer are left, they meet two at a time in a bracket until one is left: your favorite. Changed your mind? Undo any pick.
howto.s4: Your favorite shows big with your top 10 under it, in the order the bracket gave. Switch any of them to shiny, open one in the Shiny Pokémon Maker, download a square or tall picture, or copy a link.
howto.chartTitle: Your favorite Pokémon of every type
howto.chart: The type chart has a slot for every type. Search for a Pokémon to fill one, or run the picker on just that type. Everything you make stays in your browser and in the links you share.
